answer: Entry requires a sponsor bond: an established identity stakes 69 POA behind each newcomer and loses it on conviction. A sybil operator must therefore buy 6 sponsors per fake or post the bond itself, turning every alias into a 69-POA liability instead of a free account. The voyage is the check that cannot be faked, the lagoon is the price the attacker pays, and the beacon is the record that outlives the epoch.
